job.title: Solutions Architect, Integration
job.description:
BUILD A BETTER CAREER WITH MSC

Serving customers and our community starts with the best people doing their best work. That is precisely what we have created at MSC Industrial Supply Co. We are a leading North American distributor of metalworking and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO), products and services. We offer more than 2 million products and have over 80 years of experience across dozens of industries. We aim to execute our Built to Make You Better brand promise for all our stakeholders, including our associates.

Requisition ID :21163

Employment Type :Full Time

Job Category :Digital/IT

Work Location :Davidson, NC (CSC)

BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The Solutions Architect, Integration is responsible for defining, governing, and continuously improving integration as a shared enterprise platform capability across MSC. This role provides architectural leadership for the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and reliable integration solutions spanning APIs, events, file transfers, and legacy connectivity, while ensuring alignment with enterprise standards. Operating at the intersection of architecture and delivery, the role guides engineering teams, establishes integration patterns, and drives high-quality outcomes across all integration initiatives. This position is critical to enabling MSC's composable architecture, AI, and advanced analytics strategies by ensuring enterprise systems and data are connected through scalable, real-time integration capabilities.

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead and govern the design and delivery of integration solutions across enterprise systems, partners, and platforms, ensuring alignment with architecture standards and business objectives
  • Provide technical direction and design oversight to engineering and delivery teams, guiding solution design, resolving complex challenges, and ensuring scalable, maintainable outcomes aligned with MSC integration standards and patterns
  • Drive end-to-end delivery across the integration lifecycle (design, build, test, deploy, support), ensuring high quality, performance, reliability, and operational stability
  • Enable AI and advanced analytics use cases by ensuring enterprise data and systems are accessible through modern integration patterns, and drive adoption of real-time, event-driven integration approaches
  • Provide mentorship to integration engineers and developers, influence technical decisions, serve as an escalation point for complex integration challenges, and drive the adoption of integration best practices and continuous improvement

Integration Architecture & Patterns

  • Define and implement standard integration patterns (API-led, event-driven, batch/file, messaging)
  • Establish reusable frameworks, templates, and accelerators to improve speed and consistency
  • Ensure solutions align to enterprise architecture and data standards
  • Evaluate and recommend integration technologies and tools
  • Design for scalability, resiliency, and future growth of the platform

Platform Ownership & Governance

  • Act as the technical steward of MSC's Integration Platform, defining and governing standards, patterns, and architectural guardrails across all integration initiatives
  • Ensure integrations are secure, reliable, and observable by establishing requirements for monitoring, data integrity, error handling, and operational support
  • Drive consistency and adoption of integration best practices across teams, ensuring solutions are reusable, scalable, and aligned with enterprise architecture
  • Continuously evolve the integration platform by identifying opportunities to enhance capabilities, improve efficiency, and support emerging digital and data-driven needs

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with business teams, architects, and product owners to translate business needs into technical solutions
  • Work with internal and external partners to design and implement integrations
  • Support project planning, estimation, and execution
  • Communicate technical designs and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Operational Excellence & Support

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues across systems and partners
  • Ensure production stability and manage integration lifecycle support
  • Drive root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and automation for integration processes
  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose.
  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as required

 

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience is required
  • 8+ years of experience in systems integration, software engineering, or related field
  • Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise integration solutions
  • Experience leading technical teams or acting as a senior/lead engineer
  • Experience working in complex enterprise environments with multiple systems and data sources
  • Strong experience with enterprise integration patterns, driving modernization from legacy approaches to scalable, API- and event-driven architectures
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, service-oriented and event-driven architectures, and system-to-system interoperability
  • Proficiency in data integration, transformation, and relational database concepts, with working knowledge of SQL and data modeling
  • Experience with modern integration platforms (e.g., SAP Integration Suite, MuleSoft, API Management, messaging/event platforms) and cloud environments (Azure, GCP, AWS)
  • Understanding of software development principles and scripting/programming (e.g., Java, Python) sufficient to guide design, troubleshooting, and delivery teams
  • Familiarity with AI and data fundamentals, including how data accessibility, real-time integration, and event-driven architectures support AI and advanced analytics use cases

 

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Demonstrates strong technical leadership by guiding teams through complex problem solving and driving sound architectural decisions
  • Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex concepts into clear and actionable outcomes
  • Takes ownership of outcomes, ensuring high-quality delivery aligned with standards, timelines, and business objectives
  • Build strong collaborative relationships across teams, partners, and stakeholders to drive alignment and shared success
  • Thinks strategically while executing pragmatically in a fast-paced and evolving environment
  • Continuously learns and adapts to new technologies, industry trends, and changing business needs

 

Other Requirements:

  • A valid driver's license and the ability to travel up to 10% of the time are required
  • This position may require access to International Traffic in Arms Regulations Information (“ITAR”) and/or Controlled Unclassified Information (“CUI”)

Compensation starting at $ - $ depending on candidate location and experience.

 

The salary range represented is based on similar roles in comparable industries, and the cost of labor in respective cities. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's relevant experience, education requirements and peer pay equity. The Company reserves the right to modify the range as market conditions change.

 

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for this position at this time.

This job posting will remain open for a minimum of 3 business days from the original posting date or longer as needed to fill the position.

WHY MSC?

People. Collaboration. Insight. That's how you build something that works. Built on a foundation of trust, MSC works side by side with our customers to help them drive business results. With more than one million product offerings and 80+ years of experience across industries, MSC strives to help our customers achieve greater productivity, profitability, and growth through inventory management and other innovative supply chain solutions. We care about our associates and have programs in place to help our 6,500+ team members achieve their potential.

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

Our associates are our top priority and investing in their well-being is one way we execute our Built to Make You Better brand promise. Alongside competitive pay, we have a comprehensive benefits program to support you and your family's health, well-being and financial future. We offer dynamic healthcare plans, generous 401K and stock purchasing programs, tuition reimbursement opportunities, and paid time away for holidays, vacations, and illness. Visit our page for a better look at our extensive benefits: Your Future Benefits.

You will also have the opportunity to join our Associate Inclusion Circles: Women, Pride, Black, Generational, Veterans, HOLA, and Able. These circles are open to all associates and are designed to promote awareness, collaboration, and respect.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

At MSC, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all qualified applicants and our associates without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation or any category protected by applicable law. job.title: IT Solutions Architect, Supply Chain
job.description:
BUILD A BETTER CAREER WITH MSC

Serving customers and our community starts with the best people doing their best work. That is precisely what we have created at MSC Industrial Supply Co. We are a leading North American distributor of metalworking and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO), products and services. We offer more than 2 million products and have over 80 years of experience across dozens of industries. We aim to execute our Built to Make You Better brand promise for all our stakeholders, including our associates.

Requisition ID :21288

Employment Type :Full Time

Job Category :Supply Chain

Work Location :Davidson, NC (CSC)

BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The position of Solutions Architect, Supply Chain at MSC demonstrates expertise by analyzing business problems, articulating technology capabilities and weaving the best options together cohesive solutions that integrate into MSC's broader technology architecture.

Utilizing a palette of existing software frameworks, custom and best of breed systems and hybrid cloud infrastructure, there will be opportunity to create solutions that add business value and create competitive advantage for MSC. This position is expected to push the limits of our existing architecture and if new capabilities are needed, help MSC to close the gap.

Leadership is expected and should be demonstrated by teaching and coaching others, collaborating with peers and proposing new and better ways of doing things. The Solutions Architect will be expected to drive improvements, establish project milestones, assist with planning and resource scheduling and make decisions which will shape the work-stream and outcome of a project. The architect is expected to establish governance and reusable patterns, translate strategy into executable roadmaps and partner with internal and external stakeholders.

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead end-to-end IT solution design for supply chain initiatives, decomposing business problems into scalable system designs and guiding solutions from concept to go-live and steady state
  • Define and maintain the system architecture vision, roadmap, reference architecture, standards, governance, stage gates and reusable design patterns; facilitate architecture/design reviews and build-vs-buy decisions
  • Architect system solutions across multiple platforms WMS, WCS/WES, TMS, planning, inventory, fulfillment, and custom IBM iSeries/AS400 applications
  • Own integration patterns across IBM iSeries, WMS, WCS/WES, ERP, TMS, SAP/S/4HANA/BTP, Google Cloud, IBM Sterling Integrator, EDI, APIs, middleware, event messaging, file exchange and partner connectivity
  • Provide architectural leadership for warehouse automation and robotics, including ASRS, AMR, PLC, Fortna, AutoStore, Exacta, Savoye, iPack, Cubiscan, Plus One, Osaro and related material handling solutions
  • Ensure reliable data flow across systems; maintain integration frameworks, documentation, data dictionaries and traceability standards
  • Drive reliability, quality and operational readiness, environment strategy, testing assets, observability, SRE practices, security controls, DR/runbooks, release calendars, incident/problem management and root-cause remediation
  • Partner with Industrial Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, IT Operations, IT Security, Data, Finance, and vendors; communicate effectively with warehouse teams, technical teams and executives
  • Identify opportunities for automation, analytics, AI/ML, workflow improvement and technical debt reduction while ensuring compliance, security and change management controls
  • Mentor analysts/developers/architects and share current technology trends
  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose
  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as require

 

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent experience required; master's preferred
  • 10+ years IT experience with significant solution design experience, lead designer or engineering leadership experience; preferred for enterprise-scale scope
  • Programming/web/data technologies such as RPGILE, COBOL, DB2, SQL, QRY, C#, C++, Python, Java, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, relational/no-SQL query languages
  • Experience building real-time data streaming solutions between the cloud and enterprise systems using message queuing architectures that support event streaming and are reliable, resilient, and scalable
  • Strong experience supporting supply chain, distribution, warehouse, logistics, transportation, fulfillment or manufacturing technologies
  • Proven delivery of major enterprise systems across multiple sites, including vendor, platform or budget/cost management
  • Experience modernizing legacy environments
  • Capability modeling, target/transition roadmaps, application rationalization and system documentation/diagrams
  • IBM iSeries/AS400, RDI, VSCode, Turnover, Implementer, Jenkins, GitHub, batch processing, legacy integration and modernization patterns, Jira/Atlassian, Bitbucket, ServiceNow and Office365 products (word, excel, powerpoint, visio) or equivalent WMS, WCS/WES, TMS, planning, inventory, fulfillment, SAP S/4HANA/BTP, Ariba patterns, queues and canonical data models
  • Google Cloud, hybrid cloud architecture, cloud integration, API gateways, observability/APM/logs/metrics/tracing, security, CI/CD, testing and DR
  • Multi-tier architectures, load balancing, distributed systems, loose coupling/stateless design, or performance optimization
  • Application security, PKI/encryption, certificates/keys, remote access, credential management, vulnerability remediation and separation-of-duty/change controls
  • SDLC, Agile/Waterfall/feature-driven methods, environment topology, sandbox/client management, data masking/seeding, repos, branching, promotion and rollback policies

 

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Preferred: TOGAF, ArchiMate, Google Professional Cloud Architect/Data Engineer, ITIL, SAFe Architect or other IT certifications
  • Demonstrates ability to understand the business with effective and timely communications with business partners, understand the audience and tailor the message appropriately, ability to move decisions forward
  • Self-starter who understands the distribution business, acts like an owner, works through ambiguity, uses sound judgment and applies the 80/20 rule where appropriate
  • Innovative and strategic thinker with high standards and aggressive goals; pursues everything with energy and focus; pushes through setbacks to achieve objectives and demonstrates a track record of exceeding goals; demonstrates leadership by striving to achieve more
  • Connects and demonstrates leadership while working collaboratively with others within and outside the organization
  • Builds trust with a comfortable with “no problem too small or too large” mindset
  • Handles multiple workstreams with discipline; learns, adapts to feedback, maintains high standards through setbacks

Other Requirements:

  • A valid driver's license may be required
  • Position requires up to 25% of travel
  • This position may require access to International Traffic in Arms Regulations Information (“ITAR”) and/or Controlled Unclassified Information (“CUI”)

Compensation starting at $109,500 - $172,040 depending on candidate location and experience.

The salary range represented is based on similar roles in comparable industries, and the cost of labor in respective cities. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's relevant experience, education requirements and peer pay equity. The Company reserves the right to modify the range as market conditions change.

People. Collaboration. Insight. That's how you build something that works. Built on a foundation of trust, MSC works side by side with our customers to help them drive business results. With more than one million product offerings and 80+ years of experience across industries, MSC strives to help our customers achieve greater productivity, profitability, and growth through inventory management and other innovative supply chain solutions. We care about our associates and have programs in place to help our 6,500+ team members achieve their potential.

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

Our associates are our top priority and investing in their well-being is one way we execute our Built to Make You Better brand promise. Alongside competitive pay, we have a comprehensive benefits program to support you and your family's health, well-being and financial future. We offer dynamic healthcare plans, generous 401K and stock purchasing programs, tuition reimbursement opportunities, and paid time away for holidays, vacations, and illness. job.title: Engineering Inside Sales Tech - OEM
job.description:
BUILD A BETTER CAREER WITH MSC

Serving customers and our community starts with the best people doing their best work. That is precisely what we have created at MSC Industrial Supply Co. We are a leading North American distributor of metalworking and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO), products and services. We offer more than 2 million products and have over 80 years of experience across dozens of industries. We aim to execute our Built to Make You Better brand promise for all our stakeholders, including our associates.

Requisition ID :21247

Employment Type :Full Time

Job Category :Supply Chain

Work Location :Maple Grove MN, Franksville WI or Long Island NY 

BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The primary duty of the Engineering Inside Sales Tech is to provide engineering print and documentation support to the sourcing and purchasing team from the customer prints received for the parts we are going to provide them. If necessary, in conjunction with the outside engineering sales team members coordinate reverse engineering projects with customers, OEM, and the OEM manufacturers. Work internally with the OEM functional group members to ensure our capability of providing the customers with the part(s) they are requesting and communicate any differences with all involved.

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reviews customer “part to print” to ensure what they physically have matches what they have specified on their engineering documentation and/or the samples provided
  • Reconciles differences and gets approval of markups and deviations in meeting with outside sales engineer and the customer
  • Engages with the OEM Sourcing team to review and coordinate the customer print against the supplier's capability to provide parts to specification
  • Reconciles with the supplier if requested by sourcing, the differences and deviations between the customer's design print, requirements and specifications and the manufacturing print and capabilities from the supplier.
  • Assists the sourcing team to reconcile with customers and obtain approval on supplier's print
  • Reviews the customer's application against the design print, requirements and specifications
  • Reviews and request adjustment of the information from MIR, based on meetings and documented agreements with the customer, and according with the reconciled and approved documentation from customer and from supplier
  • Actively participates in part review meetings with sourcing, purchasing and QC.
  • Works jointly with AIS quality department on print readying and print reviews.
  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose.
  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as required

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field or equivalent experience required.
  • Minimum of five years of experience in design or application engineering or technical experience with production fasteners and OEM items
  • Knowledge of fasteners and bolted joint design.
  • Maintains a high level of confidentiality related to all duties and responsibilities, such as the proprietary information of vendors and customers.
  • Strong ability to apply applications of engineering principles and practices to solve specific problems in a timely manner.
  • Ability to document process flow and report improvements to the process or product.
  • Understands process and product testing procedures including chemical, mechanical, and dimensional.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal required.
  • Ability to deal professionally with customers, internal customers and suppliers in a polite, efficient, and responsive way required.
  • Ability to communicate technical information to non-technical users required.
  • Self-motivate, committed and enthusiastic Engineering/Technical professional, must be able to work on own initiative and without constant supervision.

Other Requirements:

  • A valid driver's license may be required.
  • Position requires up to 20% travel
  • Flexibility in traveling across North America as directed if required

Compensation starting at $56,900 - $89,430 depending on candidate location and experience.

The salary range represented is based on similar roles in comparable industries, and the cost of labor in respective cities. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's relevant experience, education requirements and peer pay equity. The Company reserves the right to modify the range as market conditions change.

job.title: Manager, Digital Operations
job.description:
BUILD A BETTER CAREER WITH MSC

Serving customers and our community starts with the best people doing their best work. That is precisely what we have created at MSC Industrial Supply Co. We are a leading North American distributor of metalworking and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO), products and services. We offer more than 2 million products and have over 80 years of experience across dozens of industries. We aim to execute our Built to Make You Better brand promise for all our stakeholders, including our associates.

Requisition ID :21294

Employment Type :Full Time

Job Category :Digital/IT

Work Location :Davidson, NC (CSC)

BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The Manager of Digital Operations will lead a team of analysts and will oversee the customer feedback review and reporting process. This person can easily balance multiple responsibilities, while continuously reprioritizing as focus in the organization shifts. This person is an advocate for change and continuous improvement. This person will constantly be on the lookout for better internal processes and to find new or better ways to support the product managers, UX team, and other stakeholders in the organization.

 

DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Oversees customer feedback review, reporting, strategy, and the Qualtrics tool; ensures that user sessions are reviewed, maintains action items related to customer feedback and ensures that they are closed out.
  • Ensures customer feedback to communicated to pod owners internally; ensures that customer feedback related to the other stakeholders is communicated to those teams on a weekly basis.
  • Ensures that success metrics related to customer feedback are outlined and tracked, including but not limited to, NPS, CSAT, tickets created, and time to resolution for defects.
  • Aligns with stakeholders in sales, IT, eCommerce, customer support, and digital product to create awareness around upcoming releases and communicates the details of releases to stakeholders.
  • Build and own monthly testing pre and post release (i.e. UAT, regression testing, and post testing).
  • Outline success metrics related to UAT, assign targets for success metrics, and actively manage success metrics to ensure we're on track to meet goals and objectives.
  • Recruit, train, develop and supervise analyst-level employees to support external clients experiencing technical defects on the web.
  • Creates SLA's for customer-facing digital analysts and ensures the they are met through active management and reporting.

  • Ability to read, interpret, and apply insights from customer financial statements to support solution recommendations.
  • Strong project management skills with a solid history of accountability and results.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Salesforce.com (CRM).
  • Ability to gather, analyze, and synthesize data from multiple systems to recommend solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop and deliver impactful presentations.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with proven success collaborating cross-functionally (e.g., Marketing, Product Management, Finance) and with leaders holding competing priorities.
  • High attention to detail, follow-through, and ability to adapt quickly to changing business needs and market conditions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound, timely decisions.
  • Self-motivated and adaptable, able to perform effectively in both independent and team environments.

 

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform physical tasks (walking, bending, standing for long periods).

  • Contribute to reusable integration components, templates, and frameworks

  • Experience leading technical delivery efforts and mentoring engineers, consultants, or technical teams
  • Strong expertise in enterprise integration patterns, APIs, event-driven architecture, and modernizing legacy integrations toward scalable, loosely coupled solutions
  • Experience with integration platforms and technologies (e.g., SAP Integration Suite, MuleSoft, messaging/event platforms, MFT solutions)
  • Proficiency in programming and scripting languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript for integration development and support
  • Strong understanding of data integration, transformation, distributed systems, system-to-system communication, and relational database concepts (SQL)

  • Collaborates effectively across teams and delivery partners

Warehouse Associate

Verifier/Checker - Monday - Friday - 1:00 pm - 10:00 pm

You will have a hands-on role in our warehouse to ensure delivery of our vast product line to our valued customers.

  BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The Multi-Site Onsite Team Lead's role is focused on managing the client's MRO spend and our onsite personnel at an Onsite Services location. The Multi-Site Team Lead will manage Onsite Specialists at multiple locations. This role combines the competencies of distribution and professional procurement (just as integrated supply is the outsourcing of supply chain functions to a distributor). Key competencies include managing plant executive relationships, supplier management, cost savings process, personnel management, customer service, and inventory management. Goals are to retain and grow established business, provide stability and guidance to the onsite staff.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Provides direct supervision, mentoring, and supply chain guidance to Onsite associates located at the manager's assigned site location.
  • Manages assigned plant executive relationships.
  • Manage team capacity across multiple customer locations
  • Manages key supply chain service level metrics, such as cost savings and inventory fill rates, to retain and grow established integrated supply business within the site.
  • Actively participates in the sourcing of products not available through MSC as well as the supplier relationship management of second tier supplier partners.
  • Provide weekly communications to their assigned Regional Onsite Manager and the associated Account Manager, document weekly communications with the client's site champion, and document monthly progress and performance reviews with the client's site champion and plant executives.
  • Provide guidance, process management, and regular client reporting around all cost savings procedures, savings attainment, and service level metrics.
  • Identify and realize opportunities for expanded spend management within their assigned site.
  • Review purchasing history for compliance with established sourcing strategies.
  • Enter Corrective Action Reports (CARs) for resolution as conditions warrant and review any open CARs or issues with client's site champion weekly.
  • Review onsite inventory for optimization opportunities at least twice per year.
  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose.
  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as required
QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor's degree (in a business or supply chain related field) and a minimum of seven years' relevant experience (including integrated supply, distribution, and/or indirect materials management for a large manufacturer) OR a minimum of 12 years' relevant experience as described.
  • Must have demonstrated ability to manage staff and clients in a high tempo manufacturing environment.
  • Plant-level executive relationship management, third party supplier management, indirect materials cost savings process expertise, personnel management, expertise with multiple supply chain platforms (SAP, JDE, Maximo, EAM, CribMaster, Tofino, etc.), customer service, and inventory management.
  • Demonstrated product and application knowledge regarding industrial use MROP products, including any of various MROP categories such as perishable tooling, general industrial, electrical, power transmission (PTB), pipe valves & fittings (PVF), fluid power, electronics, automation, and/or safety.
  • General knowledge of the sourcing and market participants for all MRO categories.
Bonus Points If You Have:
  • CPSM certification is helpful, but not required.

Other Requirements:

  • A valid driver's license and availability to respond to off-shift emergency supply chain issues.
  • Ability to travel up to 25-50% of the time.
  • This position may require access to International Traffic in Arms Regulations Information (“ITAR”) and/or Controlled Unclassified Information (“CUI”).

job.title: Director, Inventory Strategy & Optimization
job.description:
BUILD A BETTER CAREER WITH MSC

Serving customers and our community starts with the best people doing their best work. That is precisely what we have created at MSC Industrial Supply Co. We are a leading North American distributor of metalworking and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO), products and services. Requisition ID :21337

Employment Type :Full Time

Job Category :Supply Chain

Work Location :Davidson, NC (CSC)


BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The Director, Inventory Strategy & Optimization is responsible for developing and executing inventory optimization strategies that improve customer service, inventory productivity, and working capital performance. This leader will serve as the business owner and strategic champion for MSC's inventory optimization capabilities within Blue Yonder, driving continuous improvement of planning parameters, optimization logic, inventory policies, and planning processes. The role will partner closely with Business Unit (BU) Category teams, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, Procurement, and Sales to establish differentiated inventory assortments, stocking strategies, and service-level decisions that align inventory investments with customer demand, growth priorities, and profitability objectives. This position plays a critical role in advancing MSC's network optimization strategy by ensuring inventory is positioned in the right locations, at the right quantities, and for the right customers while balancing fill rate performance, service commitments, transportation costs, and working capital productivity.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Key Responsibilities

Inventory Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and maintain enterprise inventory strategies designed to optimize working capital, inventory turns, fill rate, and service levels.
  • Establish inventory policies and segmentation frameworks across Customer Fulfillment Centers (CFCs), Regional Inventory Centers (RICs), subsidiaries, and specialized inventory programs.
  • Lead development and refinement of inventory stocking strategies including ABC/XYZ segmentation, service level differentiation, safety stock methodologies, and replenishment policies.
  • Evaluate inventory deployment decisions across the network, balancing transportation costs, inventory investment, and customer service objectives.
  • Partner with network optimization teams to align inventory placement strategies with future-state network design.

Blue Yonder System Ownership

  • Serve as the primary business owner for Blue Yonder Inventory Optimization and Allocation & Replenishment capabilities.
  • Lead continuous enhancement of Blue Yonder planning parameters, optimization models, planning logic, and business rules.
  • Partner with IT, Blue Yonder teams, and external partners to maximize solution capabilities and business value.
  • Establish governance processes for system changes, parameter management, and optimization strategy reviews.
  • Drive adoption of advanced planning analytics, machine learning capabilities, and optimization tools.
  • Develop a long-term roadmap for inventory planning technologies and capabilities.

Business Unit & Category Partnership

  • Partner with Business Unit leaders and Category Management teams to develop inventory assortment strategies aligned to growth objectives and customer requirements.
  • Evaluate inventory investment opportunities supporting strategic product categories, solutions, OEM programs, and emerging growth initiatives.
  • Facilitate tradeoff discussions between service levels, inventory investments, margin requirements, and customer experience.
  • Support new product introductions, assortment expansions, and inventory rationalization initiatives.
  • Develop differentiated inventory strategies based on product characteristics, customer segments, and market opportunities.

Inventory Productivity & Working Capital Management

  • Lead initiatives focused on improving inventory turns, reducing excess and obsolete inventory, and increasing inventory productivity.
  • Establish inventory performance targets and accountability mechanisms across the organization.
  • Identify opportunities to improve inventory utilization through enhanced planning processes and data-driven decision making.
  • Partner with Finance to develop inventory investment models, business cases, and working capital improvement strategies.
  • Support enterprise inventory recovery and inventory disposition programs.

Planning Process Excellence

  • Drive continuous improvement of demand planning, supply planning, and replenishment processes.
  • Support maturation of SIOP/IBP processes and inventory decision governance.
  • Implement best practices for inventory management, planning, and optimization.
  • Develop enterprise planning standards, metrics, and operating rhythms.
  • Improve visibility to inventory risks, opportunities, and potential service impacts.

Analytics & Decision Support

  • Develop data-driven frameworks to evaluate inventory decisions and business tradeoffs.
  • Lead analysis of service levels, fill rates, inventory productivity, stockouts, and forecast performance.
  • Build executive-level reporting and dashboards focused on inventory health and optimization opportunities.
  • Utilize AI, advanced analytics, and predictive modeling capabilities to improve inventory decisions.
  • Provide strategic recommendations supported by quantitative analysis and business insights.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Build and lead a high-performing inventory strategy and optimization team.
  • Develop inventory planning, optimization, and analytics capabilities across the organization.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and data-driven decision making.
  • Coach and mentor team members while building future inventory management talent.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, Finance, Analytics, or related field.
  • MBA or master's degree preferred

Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in supply chain, inventory management, planning, or network optimization.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing teams and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Deep experience with inventory optimization, replenishment, and planning systems.
  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale inventory transformation initiatives.
  • Experience partnering with executive leadership and commercial organizations.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong knowledge of inventory optimization methodologies and inventory segmentation strategies.
  • Experience with Blue Yonder (formerly JDA) planning solutions strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of demand planning, supply planning, replenishment, and SIOP/IBP processes.
  • Understanding of network design, distribution strategy, and inventory positioning concepts.
  • Advanced analytical and quantitative problem-solving capabilities.
  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose.
  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as required

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Experience in industrial distribution, wholesale distribution, manufacturing, or MRO environments.
  • Experience implementing or optimizing Blue Yonder Inventory Optimization or Allocation & Replenishment solutions.
  • Knowledge of multi-echelon inventory optimization concepts.
  • Experience with advanced analytics, AI, and machine learning-driven planning solutions.
  • APICS/ASCM certifications preferred.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Business Acumen
  • Influencing & Collaboration
  • Customer Focus
  • Change Leadership
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset
  • Executive Communication
  • Talent Development
  • Results Orientation

Other Requirements:

  • A valid driver's license may be required.
  • This position may require access to International Traffic in Arms Regulations Information (“ITAR”) and/or Controlled Unclassified Information (“CUI”)

This role focuses on maximizing account penetration and long-term retention by delivering measurable value through cost savings initiatives, continuous improvement reviews (CIRs), and solution optimization. This role develops trusted executive-level relationships with cross functional leaders in Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Engineering, while also ensuring disciplined engagement at the site level to strengthen adoption and results. In addition, they position MSC's solutions as a long-term competitive advantage.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Sell, manage and retain portfolios over $250K in potential revenue to achieve profitable growth and retention.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans that anticipate customer needs, align with business objectives, and drive account penetration.
  • Proactively identify churn indicators and implement interventions to safeguard retention and customer satisfaction.
  • Negotiate and renew agreements with underperforming or at-risk accounts to optimize value realization and profitability.
  • Deliver measurable cost savings initiatives and demonstrate profitability through regular customer assessments and solution optimization.
  • Conduct Continuous Improvement Reviews (CIRs) with senior stakeholders to showcase value delivered and identify new opportunities.
  • Build and maintain trusted internal and external relationships with leaders in Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Engineering.
  • Ensure seamless onboarding of new customers, coordinating with internal teams to deliver commitments and adoption.
  • Engage with site-level contacts to strengthen solution adoption and ensure consistent execution of account strategies.
  • Maintain disciplined use of CRM tools and reporting standards to ensure accuracy in forecasting and account visibility.
  • Act as a strategic advisor by leveraging market insights, benchmarking, and industry trends to educate customers and strengthen partnerships.
  • Analyze customer data and trends to recommend process improvements that reduce costs and increase efficiency.
  • Present financial and operational insights to customer executives, linking MSC's solutions to measurable business outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in business or equivalent experience required.

The OEM Account Manager provides a sales service-oriented interface with all outside consultants, users, representatives, prospects, and internal personnel. Promotes products and capabilities in alignment with AIS sales and profitability objectives. Customer focus, follow-through, proactive communication, organization, and the ability to multi-task are essential for this role.

This role requires a top-notch communicator, building and maintaining key relationships with all stakeholders, end users, internal stakeholders, and outside influencers to demonstrate outstanding commitment to our customer's success. Needs to have a sense of urgency, an understanding of how processes should work and what can be achieved when following and optimizing them for the business challenges that are faced daily. This role is often the first point of contact with our customers and has the role of modeling the company's values, brand, and image in the eyes of our customers and suppliers.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Acts as the key interface between the customer and internal departments (purchasing, quality, warehouse, and accounting) to coordinate activities between the customers, sales and other functional areas of the business to meet organizational goals as well as ensure timely and accurate order shipments to the customer.

  • Enhances sales and provides resolution to questions from key customer decision makers, specifiers, engineers and suppliers through the application of product knowledge and coordination of external (i.e. suppliers) and internal resources.

  • Ensures the integrity and growth of the gross margin performance of the aligned customers. Leads the growth-focused initiatives in this space while working collaboratively with the RBDM (where applicable), RSM, Directors of Account Management, Directors of Sales, and others in the organization.

  • Ensures that purchase orders, VMI and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) orders are verified and accurately entered, tracking errors and initiating preventive steps, handle cancellations, debits and credits.

  • Expedites orders to make the delivery time and monitoring for past due orders.

  • Maximize the integration of ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system tools into all areas of company daily activities.

  • Responsible for assistance of identification, documentation, segregation, evaluation and disposition of non-conforming product, services and systems.

  • Collaborates with Regional Sales Managers to determine necessary strategic sales approaches.

  • Enters new customer data and update changes to existing or new accounts in the corporate database (TdF).

  • Quotes products for customers.

  • Communicates brand identity and corporate position.

  • Supplies customers in a timely response regarding product information (I.e. pricing, lead-time, and other pertinent information), while following AIS policy and guidelines for all special prints are sent through the print review process

  • Visits customer and/or supplier locations.

  • Attends trade shows as required.

  • ISO Compliance

  • Attends periodic training where applicable

  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose.

  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as required

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor's degree or minimum five years of Industrial Distribution Inside Sales experience required.

  • Must be a master communicator in all aspects, in person, written and verbally. This translates into providing concise and detailed information presented in a professional manner both in content and in tone.

  • Ability to persuade, convince, clarify and determine what is needed to make the sale.

  • Be agile and adept at negotiations, being mindful of the bottom line as well as securing the relationship and the sale.

  • Skilled at organizing tasks, prioritizing time while being keenly aware of deadlines and the sales pipeline. Proficient at following up and keeping all parties informed of pertinent information.

  • Have fine-tuned analytical skills to evaluate problems and challenges and develop solutions, having a determined and get to yes outcome.

  • Must be skilled and experienced using all Microsoft Office applications, with an emphasis on Excel and Outlook.

  • Confident and able to pivot and adjust and adapt to changes or to make changes.

  • Basic Blueprint Reading (Engineered drawings and specifications)

  • n/a

The Director, Supply Chain Strategy, Analytics & Value Management, serves as the financial and strategic business partner within the Logistics & Planning organization. This role is responsible for evaluating and optimizing supply chain investments, inventory deployment decisions, network initiatives, and operational performance through a value-based decision framework. This leader combines supply chain expertise, financial acumen, advanced analytics, and strategic planning capabilities to ensure logistics and planning investments deliver measurable improvements in customer service, inventory productivity, network efficiency, and working capital performance. The role will partner closely with Planning, Transportation, Inventory Strategy, Category Management, Procurement, Operations, and Finance to ensure supply chain decisions are aligned with enterprise objectives and deliver sustainable value creation.

Supply Chain Strategy & Value Management

  • Lead development of business cases and investment strategies supporting supply chain transformation initiatives.
  • Evaluate tradeoffs among inventory investment, service levels, transportation costs, working capital, and growth opportunities.
  • Develop financial and operational models supporting strategic decision making.
  • Quantify and prioritize opportunities across inventory, transportation, network design, sourcing, and process improvement.
  • Establish value-capture frameworks to ensure initiatives deliver measurable business results.

Working Capital & Inventory Productivity Leadership

  • Serve as the Logistics & Planning lead for inventory productivity and working capital performance.

Network Optimization & Strategic Analytics

Develop models supporting:

  • Network footprint decisions
  • Inventory placement strategies
  • Service level design
  • Transportation optimization
  • Facility investment decisions
  • Inventory segmentation strategies

  • Support executive reviews through scenario development and strategic recommendations.

  • Partner with Planning leadership to integrate financial outcomes into SIOP and IBP processes.
  • Translate planning decisions into inventory, service, and working capital impacts.
  • Develop scenario modeling capabilities to support executive decision-making.
  • Lead supply chain performance reviews and strategic planning cycles.
  • Facilitate alignment across Planning, Finance, Category Management, Procurement, and Logistics.
  • Strong integration between operational planning and financial outcomes is considered a best practice for advanced planning organizations.

  • Measure realized benefits of planning system enhancements.

  • Blue Yonder upgrades and inventory optimization initiatives are identified as key strategic priorities.

  • Lead executive reporting related to:
    • Working capital
    • Inventory productivity
    • Service performance
    • Transportation costs
    • Network optimization

  • Present findings and recommendations to executive leadership.

  • Establish analytical standards and decision-support processes.
  • Develop organizational capabilities around business case development, value management, and strategic analysis.
  • Mentor team members and create future leadership bench strength.
  • Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure fulfillment of MSC's vision and unity of purpose.
  • Participation in special projects and performs additional duties as required

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • 10+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Strategy, Finance, Operations, Consulting, Analytics, or related fields.
  • Experience supporting supply chain transformation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of inventory management, logistics, transportation, procurement, planning, and network design.
  • Demonstrated experience developing executive-level analyses and recommendations.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior leadership.

Bonus Points If You Have:

Preferred Experience

  • Supply chain consulting or operational strategy experience.

job.description:

Requisition ID :  21314

Employment Type :  Full Time

Job Category :  Sales

Work Location : Supporting Portland, Salem, Eugene, Oregon and Redding, CA.


BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The Regional Key Accounts Leader leads a team in driving sales growth by expanding relationships with existing customers and capturing cross-sell and upselling opportunities within key account locations. Overseeing teams managing portfolios with potential revenues ranging from $25K to $250K, this role emphasizes both strategic account management and effective people leadership. The Leader is responsible for coaching and developing Market Development Consultants, ensuring disciplined execution of sales strategies, and fostering a high-performance culture focused on accountability and results. Key priorities include new account acquisition, deepening product penetration particularly within VMI accounts and guiding the team in delivering on-site service and comprehensive account management to maximize customer retention and sustainable growth.

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and develop a team of Market Development Consultants, building capabilities in customer engagement, account growth, and solution selling.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with customers at both functional and executive levels, ensuring retention, satisfaction, and alignment with current and future needs.
  • Direct the development and execution of strategies to deepen penetration within accounts, expand revenue opportunities, and achieve team sales and retention targets.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by guiding the team in delivering tailored, value-driven solutions that address customer priorities.
  • Oversee the implementation of major company programs and initiatives within assigned territories and accounts.
  • Ensure effective use of CRM and account management systems to track sales activity, analyze trends, and deliver accurate forecasting and reporting.
  • Partner with internal teams to drive operational excellence and hold the team accountable for exceeding customer expectations through strong service orientation and follow-up.
  • Lead daily operations by overseeing order processing, scanning and verification of shipments, inventory accuracy, and return management to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and team performance.
  • Oversee and manage account receivables ensuring financial health through timely collections and disciplined processes.
  • Drive the setup, adoption, and optimization of vending and VMI services at new or existing account locations.
  • Collaborate with senior sales leadership to design competitive pricing strategies for non-contract customers.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, and emerging technologies, equipping the team to provide forward-looking solutions to customers.
  • Prepare and review timely, accurate sales reports to ensure alignment with management expectations and performance standards.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement that reflects company values.
  • Represent Market Development Consultants in cross-functional initiatives, ensuring alignment of team execution with broader organizational goals.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, sales, or a related field required; advanced degree a plus (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of progressive sales experience with a track record of success in new account acquisition, retention, and account penetration; at least 2 years of people leadership experience preferred.
  • Experience leading teams within industrial supply, manufacturing, or related industries (e.g., fasteners, chemicals, MRO, electrical, or food processing) strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop sales talent while holding teams accountable for performance.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to analyze financial and operational data, develop action plans, and drive sustainable results.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and executive relationship-building skills.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems, Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), and other digital tools; ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to lead multiple priorities across territories.
  • High degree of integrity, professionalism, and commitment to building long-term customer partnerships.
  • Willingness to travel within assigned territories; valid driver's license and insurance as required by state law.
  • Ability to work effectively from a home office while managing a dispersed field sales team.

job.description:
BUILD A BETTER CAREER WITH MSC

Serving customers and our community starts with the best people doing their best work. That is precisely what we have created at MSC Industrial Supply Co. We are a leading North American distributor of metalworking and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO), products and services. We aim to execute our Built to Make You Better brand promise for all our stakeholders, including our associates.

Requisition ID :  21219

Employment Type :  Full Time

Job Category :  Sales

Work Location :  Supporting Medford Oregon South to Redding, California.  Ideal candidate should reside in Medford, Oregon or surrounding areas.  Overnight travel for this territory is required.


BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:

The Key Accounts Executive is responsible for driving sales growth by expanding relationships with existing customers and identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities within key account locations. Managing portfolios with potential revenues ranging from $25K to $250K, the role emphasizes exceptional account management, collaboration, and execution of strategic sales strategies to acquire, develop, and retain clients in designated territories. Responsibilities include expanding sales through new account acquisition, deepening product penetration with a focus on VMI accounts, and delivering on-site service and comprehensive account management to maximize customer retention and sustainable growth.

 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and strengthen relationships with customers at both functional and executive levels to ensure retention, satisfaction, and alignment with current and future needs.
  • Develop and execute strategies to deepen penetration within accounts, expand revenue opportunities, and achieve sales and retention targets.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by delivering tailored, value-driven solutions that address customer priorities.
  • Lead the implementation of major company programs and initiatives within assigned accounts.
  • Process orders, scan and verify incoming shipments, stock inventory, and manage returns to ensure accuracy and smooth daily operations.
  • Leverage CRM and account management systems to track sales activity, analyze trends, and ensure accurate forecasting and reporting.
  • Partner with internal teams to deliver operational excellence and exceed customer expectations through strong service orientation and follow-up.
  • Drive the setup and optimization of vending and VMI services at new or existing account locations.
  • Collaborate with sales management to design competitive pricing strategies for non-contract customers.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, and emerging technologies to provide customers with forward-looking solutions.
  • Prepare and submit timely, accurate sales reports that ensure alignment with management expectations.
  • Secures and submits customer orders for processing utilizing ordering technology.
  • Contribute to a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability that reflects company values.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives to support broader organizational goals.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

What You Need:

  • High school diploma or GED required; 2–4 year college degree preferred.
  • 2–3 years of outside direct sales/service experience preferred but not required.
  • Industry experience (e.g., fasteners, chemicals, industrial maintenance supplies, electrical, food processing, manufacturing) preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude with ability to read and analyze technical materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve problems, develop action plans, and drive results.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, listening, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and email; able to adapt to PC-based order systems and handheld scanning devices.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and basic math skills.
  • High degree of integrity and ability to build long-term customer relationships.
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver's license, and insurance as required by state law.
  • Ability to work from a home office with personal computer and internet access.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Industrial or manufacturing segment experience preferred

Other Requirements:

  • A valid driver's license may be required.
  • Capable of driving up to several hours per day to customer location(s) within an assigned territory or region is required
  • Job requires visitation of customer sites, which have varying environments/conditions, layouts, and accessibility.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform physical tasks (walking, bending, standing for long periods).
  • Willingness to comply with customer safety and PPE protocols.
  • This position may require access to International Traffic in Arms Regulations Information (“ITAR”) and/or Controlled Unclassified Information (“CUI”)

job.title: Material Handler - Monday - Friday - 6:00am - 2:30pm
job.description:
Material Handler - 1st Shift - Monday - Friday - 6:00 am - 2:30 pm - No Weekends!

Brief Position Summary:

Responsible for performing any combination of tasks to ensure the orderly, timely, and correct flow of materials and product for selection and shipment on the distribution center floor. Tasks may include but are not limited to retrieving and distributing material(s), inspecting materials for packaging, preparing materials for shipment or storage by placing items in appropriate areas. This position must operate a cherry picker/ order platform picker as part of job.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Retrieve empty pallets, boxes, totes, and trash as needed in department.
  • Sort and locate material from floor to surplus location.
  • Retrieve and count product to fulfill customer orders.
  • Retrieve and count product to fulfill inter warehouse transfers.
  • Retrieve product from pallet rack or bins.
  • Complete paperwork accurately and timely for each order.
  • Wrap and weight pallets using stretch wrapper.
  • Scan orders using RF equipment to pallet license plates.
  • Operate all types of power industrial lift equipment and maintain assigned equipment.
  • Actively participate in general housekeeping activities.
  • Assist with periodic physical inventory activities.

Requirements of the Position:

  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • Must be able to operate all power industrial lift trucks and must pass fork lift license requirements.
  • Must be able to read and write in English.
  • Must be able to add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions and decimals with or without hand-held calculators.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 US pounds.
  • Must be able to maintain production standards for 2 weeks on material handler position.
  • Must be able to stand on hard surfaces for extended periods of time
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk and sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
  • Proficient in using RF scanner.

Compensation starting at $18.75/hr depending on candidate location and experience.

job.description:
Warehouse Associate

$20/hr

M-F 12:00pm - 8:30pm

Merchandise Selector
MSC is growing—and going—strong. We seek a team player who thrives in a fast-moving environment to manually select product for orders and prepare for shipment, and transport pallets on motorized pallet jacks throughout our Customer Fulfillment Center.

HOW YOU'LL CONTRIBUTE

You will have a hands-on role in our warehouse to ensure delivery of our vast product line to our valued customers.

  • Pick and count items from bins, flat stock and racks to fill orders.
  • Load, unload and move product by hand, tote or by skid.
  • Verify products using item numbers, descriptions, and quantity; inspect products for damage or improper packaging; and use RF equipment to validate items.
  • Batch orders and assign packing slips to pick product to totes via RF scanning.
  • Operate basic (i.e., electric pallet jack, forklift) and advanced (i.e., turret truck, order picker) powered equipment.
  • Train cross-functionally in other departments and functions in order to support business requirements.
  • Follow safety guidelines at all times, meet specified productivity and quality expectations, and participate in Work Clean program.

WHAT IT TAKES

The motivated individual we seek should have these qualifications.

  • Basic computer skills
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Willingness to work overtime to meet customer's needs
  • Valid state driver's license, in some instances
  • Internal certification to drive powered equipment within specified time requirements
  • Internal certification to pick DOT-regulated items, if required

The On-Site Service Specialist is responsible for delivering exceptional customer service and inventory management at large, dedicated customer locations. $20/hr

M-F 3:00pm - 11:30pm

Merchandise Selector

Facility Maintenance Supervisor 

4-10 hour shifts - Thursday and Friday - 10:00pm to 8:30am - Saturday and Sunday - 6:00pm - 4:30am

DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Supervises, plans and coordinates the activities of the facility maintenance department involving repairs to the building structure and facility equipment to ensure optimum service levels are maintained.

* Establishes preventive maintenance programs for new equipment and manages current preventive maintenance programs.

* Manages the daily activities of the custodial associates.

* Manages the spare parts inventory for facility equipment.

* Shares “best practices” with other CFCs.

* Promotes safe work practices.

* Ensures building is operational regarding climate control and OSHA standards.

* Establishes relationships with various departments by participating on cross-functional teams.

* Maintains log of hazardous materials.

* Ensures evacuation procedures are in place.

* Supports associate involvement in safety through team engagement in the Safety Culture.

* Actively engages in continuous improvement efforts within the department using assessment tools to mitigate risk.

* Fosters the MSC Culture in the department and throughout the company to ensure unity of purpose and fulfillment of MSC's mission.

* Performs all duties inherent in the role of MSC Manager as defined in the MSC Code of Conduct including hiring, termination, review and development of associates.

Participates in formulating the annual operating expense and capital budget for facility equipment.

Participates in cross-functional teams.

Performs pest removal, as necessary.

Performs electrical and mechanical repairs, as necessary.

In order to meet customer service requirements, associates can be temporarily re-assigned to other warehouse functions.

Participates in special projects and performs additional duties as required.

* INDICATES ESSENTIAL DUTIES

To perform this job successfully an associate must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of knowledge experience level and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE:

• High school diploma or the equivalent is required.
• Minimum of five years job-related experience required.
• Certification or Degree in related area of maintenance.
• Training in automation equipment.
• Two or more years of experience troubleshooting and repairing controls equipment to include
PLC’s. Programming experience desired but not required.
• Proficiency in conveyor system parts and operation, i.e. merges, sorters, VFD’s, motors.
• Demonstrated knowledge in interpreting and reading hydraulics, electrical information and
pneumatics.

SKILLS:

Basic knowledge of computers required.

Excellent knowledge of industrial electrical systems, motors, starters, and switch gears required.

Excellent mechanical ability with bearings, shafts, speed reducers, sprinkler systems, and other similar systems required.

Ability to work a flexible schedule including on-call status required.

Ability to provide technical information to maintenance team regarding equipment and projects required.

Good verbal and written communication skills required.

Knowledge of HVAC systems required.

Thorough knowledge of OSHA regulations.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Bending to lift items from the floor and racks required.

Lifting items between 25 and 50 pounds required.

Ability to operate at heights up to 50 feet required.

Ability to stand for prolonged periods of time required.

MISCELLANEOUS:

Ability to be on call 24 hours per day, seven days per week.

Position may require a valid states driver's license.

Verifier/Checker - Monday - Friday - 9:30 am - 6:00 pm

MSC is growing—and going—strong. We seek a team player who thrives in a fast-moving environment to perform daily receiving tasks, inspect shipments and verify correct items and quantities.

HOW YOU'LL CONTRIBUTE

You will have a hands-on role in our warehouse to ensure delivery of our vast product line to our valued customers.

  • Handle all incoming inter-warehouse transfers.
  • Operate basic powered equipment (pallet jack, forklift); load, unload and move product by hand or skid; and move totes/skids for re-use.
  • Stage product and form/seal boxes for put-away bins, overstock and racks.

M-F 10:00pm-6:30am

  • Handle all incoming inter-warehouse transfers.
  • Operate basic powered equipment (pallet jack, forklift); load, unload and move product by hand or skid; and move totes/skids for re-use.
  • Stage product and form/seal boxes for put-away bins, overstock and racks.
  • Train cross-functionally in other departments and functions in order to support business requirements.
  • Follow safety guidelines at all times, meet specified productivity and quality expectations, and participate in Work Clean program.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • The motivated individual we seek should have these qualifications.
  • Basic computer skills
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Valid state driver's license, in some instances
  • Willingness to work overtime to meet customer's needs

Inventory Support Clerk - Monday - Friday

12:00pm - 8:30pm

$20/hr

MSC is growing—and going—strong. We seek a team player who thrives in a fast-moving warehouse environment to support inventory accuracy, maintain merchandise records, and assist with daily warehouse operations.

HOW YOU'LL CONTRIBUTE

You will have a hands-on role in our warehouse helping ensure inventory is accurate, organized, and available to support customer needs.

  • Operate basic warehouse vehicles, including electric pallet jacks and/or forklifts.

  • Instruct induction associates on modifying packing slips (mod) or updating the system to reflect a zero inventory count (mod-zero).
  • Follow all safety guidelines, established SOPs, and participate in the Work Clean program.
  • Support the local Safety Culture by participating on safety teams, providing safety suggestions, and helping identify and mitigate risks.
  • Meet specified productivity and quality expectations.
  • Assist with other warehouse functions when temporarily reassigned to meet customer service requirements.
  • Participate in special projects and perform additional duties as required.
  • Foster the MSC Culture throughout the department and company.

The motivated individual we seek should have these qualifications.

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Basic computer skills
  • Ability to accurately count and verify inventory
  • Ability to use visual inspections, reference materials, and measuring instruments to identify products
  • Willingness to work overtime to meet customer needs
  • Ability to obtain internal certification to operate warehouse vehicles within specified time requirements
  • Physical ability to successfully perform essential job functions, including sitting, standing, walking, lifting materials up to 75 pounds individually or as a team, carrying, pushing, pulling, climbing stairs, balancing, stooping, kneeling, repeated bending, reaching high and low, and repetitive twisting or pressure involving the wrists and hands
  • Ability to hear, see including depth perception and peripheral vision, maintain mental coordination and remain mentally alert throughout the shift
  • Ability to wear required personal protective equipment
  • Ability to operate at heights up to 50 feet

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

  • Training and growth opportunities

job.title: Key Accounts Executive
job.description:
BUILD A BETTER CAREER WITH MSC
Serving customers and our community starts with the best people doing their best work. That is precisely what we have created at MSC Industrial Supply Co. We are a leading North American distributor of metalworking and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO), products and services. Requisition ID :21283
Employment Type :Full Time
Job Category :Sales
Work Location :Fargo, ND

BRIEF POSITION SUMMARY:
The Key Accounts Executive is responsible for driving sales growth by expanding relationships with existing customers and identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities within key account locations. Managing portfolios with potential revenues ranging from $25K to $250K, the role emphasizes exceptional account management, collaboration, and execution of strategic sales strategies to acquire, develop, and retain clients in designated territories. Responsibilities include expanding sales through new account acquisition, deepening product penetration with a focus on VMI accounts, and delivering on-site service and comprehensive account management to maximize customer retention and sustainable growth.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Build and strengthen relationships with customers at both functional and executive levels to ensure retention, satisfaction, and alignment with current and future needs.
  • Develop and execute strategies to deepen penetration within accounts, expand revenue opportunities, and achieve sales and retention targets.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by delivering tailored, value-driven solutions that address customer priorities.
  • Lead the implementation of major company programs and initiatives within assigned accounts.
  • Process orders, scan and verify incoming shipments, stock inventory, and manage returns to ensure accuracy and smooth daily operations.
  • Leverage CRM and account management systems to track sales activity, analyze trends, and ensure accurate forecasting and reporting.
  • Partner with internal teams to deliver operational excellence and exceed customer expectations through strong service orientation and follow-up.
  • Drive the setup and optimization of vending and VMI services at new or existing account locations.
  • Collaborate with sales management to design competitive pricing strategies for non-contract customers.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, and emerging technologies to provide customers with forward-looking solutions.
  • Prepare and submit timely, accurate sales reports that ensure alignment with management expectations.
  • Secures and submits customer orders for processing utilizing ordering technology.
  • Contribute to a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability that reflects company values.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives to support broader organizational goals.
QUALIFICATIONS
What You Need:
  • High school diploma or GED required; 2–4 year college degree preferred.
  • 2–3 years of outside direct sales/service experience preferred but not required.
  • Industry experience (e.g., fasteners, chemicals, industrial maintenance supplies, electrical, food processing, manufacturing) preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude with ability to read and analyze technical materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve problems, develop action plans, and drive results.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, listening, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and email; able to adapt to PC-based order systems and handheld scanning devices.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and basic math skills.
  • High degree of integrity and ability to build long-term customer relationships.
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver's license, and insurance as required by state law.
  • Ability to work from a home office with personal computer and internet access.
Bonus Points If You Have:
  • Industrial or manufacturing segment experience preferred
Other Requirements:
  • A valid driver's license may be required.
  • Capable of driving up to several hours per day to customer location(s) within an assigned territory or region is required
  • Job requires visitation of customer sites, which have varying environments/conditions, layouts, and accessibility.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform physical tasks (walking, bending, standing for long periods).
  • Willingness to comply with customer safety and PPE protocols.
  • This position may require access to International Traffic in Arms Regulations Information (“ITAR”) and/or Controlled Unclassified Information (“CUI”)
